purpose: Correlate static Stage COLI records with native per-wheel surface masks before changing DD-wheel material behavior.

samplePolicy.recommended: emit on any surfaceMask/loadColiType/stage/roadSection change; optional <=10Hz heartbeat
samplePolicy.reason: Preserves transitions without per-frame log volume.

derived.name: leftRightSplit
derived.formula: compare FL/RL against FR/RR raw masks

derived.name: frontRearSplit
derived.formula: compare FL/FR against RL/RR raw masks

interpretationRules: Raw surfaceMask is the primary identity; roughness is derived intensity evidence.
Never infer an exact raw mask from ambiguous roughness values such as 0.35 or 0.85.
Do not assign names like curb/grass/snow until runtime masks correlate with a static COLI field or an independently proven game semantic.
Keep DD-wheel feel parameters separate from original Xbox roughness values.
successCriteria: Repeated passes over the same physical region reproduce the same raw mask pattern.
Forward/reverse stages correlate to equivalent static collision attributes where geometry/material is shared.
A candidate COLI attribute predicts raw surfaceMask transitions across at least two distinct stages before receiving a semantic material name.
